title: Best Traditional Movies of 2026 (So Far): VirtueVigil's Top 10 by Score
description: The 10 highest-scoring traditional movies of 2026 based on VirtueVigil's dual WOKE/TRAD analysis framework, ranked by net traditional margin. Updated as new reviews publish.
intro: 2026 is not the disaster year some conservative viewers feared. The data says so. VirtueVigil has reviewed over 60 films released in 2026 and the traditional side of the ledger is stacked. These are the 10 films with the highest net traditional margins, scored using the VirtueVigil dual WOKE/TRAD methodology. Rankings are by score margin, not editorial preference. The data built this list. If you want to know what is safe to watch and what actually rewards your trust, start here.

entries.title: A Great Awakening (2026)
entries.blurb: The highest-scoring traditional film of 2026 so far tells the story of the unlikely friendship between George Whitefield and Benjamin Franklin during the First Great Awakening. Sight and Sound Films does not hedge. TradScore 28.7, WokeScore 0.35. Faith is treated as a genuine force of civilization, not a character flaw to be overcome. Take your skeptic friends. The Whitefield-Franklin story is real, historically documented, and more interesting than anything Hollywood invented this year.

entries.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge (2026)
entries.blurb: Bollywood delivered the most unapologetically patriotic action film of the year, and Aditya Dhar did it at 229 minutes without a single apology for its subject matter. WokeScore zero. A perfect zero. TradScore 26.74. Hollywood has spent a decade loading every action film with institutional guilt trips and second-act reckonings. Dhurandhar does not bother. National honor, masculine sacrifice, and the duty to protect your country are the film's entire argument, and it makes that argument at operatic scale.

entries.title: Psycho Killer (2026)
entries.blurb: Andrew Kevin Walker wrote Se7en and waited decades for Hollywood to let him make another moral crime film. The wait was worth it. TradScore 29.0, WokeScore 3.0. Psycho Killer treats evil as genuinely evil and frames justice as an absolute rather than a social construction. The film respects its audience enough to take morality seriously. That alone puts it in rare company in 2026 American cinema.

entries.title: Beast (2026)
entries.blurb: An MMA legend who walked away from fighting and became a commercial fisherman gets dragged back into the cage when the people he loves are threatened. TradScore 27.0, WokeScore 1.5. Beast is the masculine protector story done exactly right: the violence is not framed as a pathology, the man defending his family is the unambiguous hero, and the film never once stops to question whether that protection instinct is problematic. The genre Hollywood used to build careers on, with no apologies attached.

entries.title: Shelter (2026)
entries.blurb: Jason Statham plays a former government assassin living off-grid in Scotland who is pulled back into violence to protect someone who needs him. TradScore 32.0, the highest raw traditional score in the 2026 top 10. The masculine protector framework is the entire film: no revision, no deconstruction, no third-act speech about the cost of the male gaze. Shelter trusts Statham to be Statham and trusts the audience to want exactly that.

entries.title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man (2026)
entries.blurb: Six seasons of television promised a masculine, violent, morally serious crime drama. The film delivered. TradScore 28.0, WokeScore 5.0. Tommy Shelby comes out of hiding to save his son and fight fascists during Britain's darkest hour, and the film treats loyalty, sacrifice, and the weight of legacy as genuine virtues rather than toxic inheritance to be shed. Cillian Murphy gives the performance the character always deserved.

entries.title: The Optimist: The Bravest Act Is Truth (2026)
entries.blurb: A small independent film about a real Holocaust survivor who kept his past secret for 60 years, and the friendship that finally gave him the courage to speak. TradScore 24.82, WokeScore 3.01. It is not political. It does not have a celebrity press tour. It is a quietly devastating story about human dignity, truth-telling, and the courage it takes to carry a burden and then set it down. The kind of film that deserves ten times the audience it will find.

entries.title: Solo Mio (2026)
entries.blurb: Kevin James flies to Italy for his wedding and gets left at the altar. Instead of flying home, he stays. TradScore 21.88, WokeScore 1.0. Solo Mio is a warm, funny, unashamed comedy about a man discovering that his real life was waiting somewhere other than where he was looking. Traditional romance, accountability, and the idea that love requires showing up are the film's entire engine. One of the most pleasant surprises of 2026.

entries.title: Project Hail Mary (2026)
entries.blurb: A man wakes up alone in a spacecraft with no memory of who he is or why he is there, and chooses in the end to stay in a distant solar system because someone else needs him more than Earth does. TradScore 26.88, WokeScore 6.05. Project Hail Mary is the most morally coherent science fiction film in years: sacrifice as its own reward, competence celebrated without apology, and the conviction that some things are worth giving everything for. Ryan Gosling earned this one.

entries.title: I Swear (2026)
entries.blurb: A biographical drama about John Davidson, a Scottish man with Tourette syndrome who became an advocate for understanding and dignity. TradScore 22.1, WokeScore 1.4. I Swear celebrates family love and personal courage without flinching from what those things cost. It rejects pity and shame with equal firmness. The measure of a person is their heart, not their condition. A film that trusts its audience to handle genuine emotion without a safety net.

title: Best Traditional Movies of 2025: VirtueVigil's Top 10 by Score
description: The 10 highest-scoring traditional movies of 2025 based on VirtueVigil's 50-trope analysis framework, ranked by score margin.
intro: If you want the most traditional movies of 2025, skip the guesswork. VirtueVigil scores every film on a dual scale measuring traditional values and progressive ideological content. This list ranks the 10 highest-scoring films of 2025 by net traditional margin, from the dominant leader at +41.8 down to the tightly-contested tenth spot at +20.3. These are not editorial picks. The data built this list. Every film links to its full VirtueVigil review with trope audits, parental guidance, and complete scoring breakdowns.

entries.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants (2025)
entries.blurb: The franchise's fourth theatrical outing leads every 2025 film by a wide margin, and it earned the top spot by doing one thing exactly right: telling a story about friendship and loyalty with no social agenda attached. TradScore 43.1, WokeScore 1.3. Parents can sit down with their kids and watch this without being surprised by an ideological third act.

entries.title: Ne Zha 2 (2025)
entries.blurb: The highest-grossing animated film ever made and the most purely traditional film on this list, with a WokeScore of exactly zero. Ne Zha 2 is built around filial loyalty, destiny, and sacrifice in a Taoist mythology framework that treats its moral weight seriously. Hollywood could not make this film. China did.

entries.title: How to Train Your Dragon (2025)
entries.blurb: A son proving himself to a skeptical father, masculine mentorship done right, and a community that gets to be wrong before it learns. Dean DeBlois delivered a live-action remake that respects the source material and adds nothing it did not need. TradScore 33.2, WokeScore 4.7.

entries.title: Happy Gilmore 2 (2025)
entries.blurb: Adam Sandler's long-awaited sequel leans into the same anti-establishment, competitive masculinity that made the original a cult favorite, and it works. TradScore 31.2, WokeScore 3.5. No lecture, no growth arc toward sensitivity, just a guy who hits golf balls too hard and wins anyway.

entries.title: David (2025)
entries.blurb: Angel Studios delivered a bold animated biblical musical that does not flinch from David's failures or his faith. TradScore 28.0, WokeScore 2.0. For families seeking a film that treats scripture with genuine craft and without apology, this is essential 2025 viewing.

entries.title: Brave the Dark (2025)
entries.blurb: A high school teacher in 1980s Pennsylvania discovers a student living on the streets and takes him in. Faith is treated as a source of strength, not an obstacle to overcome. TradScore 26.2, WokeScore 1.4. Quiet, honest, and the kind of film traditional families can discuss afterward.

entries.title: Karate Kid: Legends (2025)
entries.blurb: Older men teaching a young man to be disciplined, honorable, and brave. Jackie Chan and Ralph Macchio both appear, and the film uses that torch-passing as actual story rather than nostalgia bait. TradScore 26.3, WokeScore 3.1. The original 1984 values are intact.

entries.title: The Accountant 2 (2025)
entries.blurb: Christian Wolff returns with his code of ethics intact and his capacity for violence still framed as a moral asset, not a liability. TradScore 26.5, WokeScore 4.2. The film trusts its audience and rewards them with a values-grounded story that does not need to announce itself.

entries.title: Last Breath (2025)
entries.blurb: A true story about a diver trapped 300 feet below the North Sea and the crew who refuses to leave him. No subtext, no agenda, just male competence under impossible pressure and the bond of brotherhood. TradScore 24.3, WokeScore 3.4.

entries.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning (2025)
entries.blurb: Tom Cruise's final Ethan Hunt film is built on loyalty, sacrifice, and the conviction that some things are worth dying for. TradScore 21.4, WokeScore 1.1. Old-school action filmmaking that respects its audience and never frames Western institutions as the real enemy.
